text.zh_cn: 变身后携带火炮和同口径炮弹。弹药轮盘可选择弹种，示例使用 HE 榴弹。
text.en_us: While transformed, carry a cannon and compatible shells. Select the shell type in the ammo wheel; this example uses HE.

text.zh_cn: 对准目标使用火控选择键（默认鼠标中键）；预测提示辅助瞄准，但不会保证命中。
text.en_us: Point at the target and use fire-control select (middle mouse by default). The prediction helps aim but does not guarantee a hit.

text.zh_cn: 按住右键进入瞄准镜，左键开火；开火后观察落点，再修正瞄准。
text.en_us: Hold right-click for the scope and left-click to fire. Observe the impact and correct your aim.

text.zh_cn: 装填完成且膛内有弹后可以再次射击。自动装填炮会自行开始；手动炮可按装填键（默认 R）启动。
text.en_us: Once the reload finishes and a shell is chambered, fire again. Automatic guns reload themselves; manual guns can start reloading with the reload key (R by default).
